scenes.description: A fully clothed adult feeling fresh after a shower, drying short damp hair with a towel, relaxed shoulders and a clean refreshed smile. A bright simple bathroom without products or labels.
A person admires a short neat haircut in a mirror, wearing a barber's cape scattered with fresh clippings.
A simple dish holds fresh cucumber and citrus slices beside a clear glass of water, without heavy dressing.
